units.english: The origin of this Wardragon is shrouded in mystery. It was said that the Quarg once used this ship as a powerful light warship. Other sources suggest that it was used as a front-line heavy warship. One thing is for certain though, and that's its design is far different than any Quarg ship that exists today, and one can only question where it came from.
units.italian: L'origine di questo Wardragon è avvolta nel mistero. Si diceva che i Quarg usassero un tempo questa nave come potente nave da guerra leggera. Altre fonti suggeriscono che servisse come nave da guerra pesante di prima linea. Una cosa però è certa: il suo progetto è molto diverso da quello di qualsiasi nave Quarg esistente oggi, e non resta che chiedersi da dove venga.

units.english: You're sure there's a Southbound Shipyards Fury under all the extra modifications. This ship appears to be one man's insane quest to make the most powerful single-pilot warship ever; after close inspection, you're inclined to believe he may have succeeded.
units.italian: Sei sicuro che sotto tutte le modifiche ci sia una Fury dei Southbound Shipyards. Questa nave sembra il folle progetto di un uomo solo: costruire la nave da guerra monoposto più potente di sempre; dopo un esame attento, sei portato a credere che forse ci sia riuscito.

units.english: This ship appears to be a hollowed-out asteroid filled with strange equipment. It is unclear what is creating the rays of light, but they must have something to do with how it moves without obvious engines.
units.italian: Questa nave sembra un asteroide svuotato e riempito di apparecchiature strane. Non è chiaro che cosa produca i raggi di luce, ma devono avere a che fare con il modo in cui si muove senza motori visibili.

units.english: Its advanced properties also allow it to reject the influence of enemy Command Centers, nullifying their effect.
units.italian: Le sue proprietà avanzate gli permettono anche di respingere l'influenza dei Centri di Comando nemici, annullandone l'effetto.

units.english: Never underestimate the power of a bunch of crystals on a rock. In this case all they do is project some harmless purple rays around the Shooting Star, but the point still stands.
units.italian: Never underestimate the power of a bunch of crystals on a rock. In this case all they do is project some harmless purple rays around the Shooting Star, but the point still stands.

units.english: The real core of the Shooting Star, this floating crystal uses the effects of space-time to reduce the distance between a ship and its target. Legend has it this is no different from a thruster, but conventional engines don't bring your enemy closer.
units.italian: The real core of the Shooting Star, this floating crystal uses the effects of space-time to reduce the distance between a ship and its target. Legend has it this is no different from a thruster, but conventional engines don't bring your enemy closer.

units.english: It also takes up a spinal mount slot to be installed, although you aren't sure why.
units.italian: It also takes up a spinal mount slot to be installed, although you aren't sure why.

units.english: There appear to have been several prior attempts to discern the mechanics of this outfit, but the debate is still ongoing whether this can be considered a device or not.
units.italian: There appear to have been several prior attempts to discern the mechanics of this outfit, but the debate is still ongoing whether this can be considered a device or not.

units.english: 'Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic,' Arthur C. Clarke said. This is sufficiently advanced technology.
units.italian: 'Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic,' Arthur C. Clarke said. This is sufficiently advanced technology.

units.english: Although in appearance it may look somewhat similar to a tree, you don't know how it is supposed to resemble a skeleton. You aren't sure you want to find out either.
units.italian: Although in appearance it may look somewhat similar to a tree, you don't know how it is supposed to resemble a skeleton. You aren't sure you want to find out either.

units.english: I wouldn't recommend shooting at me, because your gun goes "pew pew," but my gun goes BBBRRRRRRR!
units.italian: Non ti consiglio di spararmi, perché la tua arma fa "piu piu", mentre la mia fa BBBRRRRRRR!

units.english: No matter how maligned, every ship has someone out there that loves it.
units.italian: Per quanto sia disprezzata, ogni nave ha qualcuno, là fuori, che la ama.

units.english: Surprisingly, someone invested a lot of time, money, and effort into transforming this humble boxwing from a flying coffin into a palatial sarcophagus. It is still terribly cramped, but at least it is luxurious and shiny!
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, qualcuno ha investito molto tempo, denaro e impegno per trasformare questa umile boxwing da bara volante in un sarcofago da palazzo. È ancora terribilmente angusta, ma almeno è lussuosa e scintillante!

units.english: Never underestimate how far an individual is willing to go to modify their favorite spacecraft - sometimes before it even exists.
units.italian: Non sottovalutare mai fin dove può arrivare qualcuno pur di modificare la propria astronave preferita: a volte prima ancora che esista.

units.english: This is a personally obtained prototype Fusion Cannon, a deadly, massive spinal weapon. Where it came from, nobody knows except the owner, and those who wish to ask are too afraid of being on the receiving end.
units.italian: This is a personally obtained prototype Fusion Cannon, a deadly, massive spinal weapon. Where it came from, nobody knows except the owner, and those who wish to ask are too afraid of being on the receiving end.

units.english: This is an old war-torn Hai Ladybug with numerous modifications done on the hull. Apart from the additional turret mounts, the main adjustments on the vessel are three huge engine cells - two in the back replacing the old engine pods, and one in the front replacing the gun mounts. These push the Modified Ladybug to speeds only an insane captain would enjoy.
units.italian: Questa è una vecchia Ladybug Hai segnata dalla guerra, con numerose modifiche allo scafo. Oltre ai punti di montaggio aggiuntivi per le torrette, le modifiche principali sono tre enormi celle motore: due dietro, al posto delle vecchie gondole, e una davanti, al posto dei supporti per i cannoni. Spingono la Modified Ladybug a velocità che solo un capitano pazzo apprezzerebbe.

units.english: The Waverider was a ship that was first requested and never used for five years, seven months and twenty-seven days.
units.italian: La Waverider è una nave richiesta e mai usata per cinque anni, sette mesi e ventisette giorni.

units.english: Its disappointment was so immense, it willed itself into being.
units.italian: La sua delusione era così immensa che si è fatta esistere con la sola volontà.

units.english: The physical embodiment of everything that makes the Reviewers who they are today.
units.italian: The physical embodiment of everything that makes the Reviewers who they are today.

units.english: Unfortunately, it's not for sale.
units.italian: Unfortunately, it's not for sale.

units.english: The Hauler cargo ships are considered by many to be outdated, and it is unclear if upgrading the cargo space to six containers is sufficient to make this Hauler ship popular. It certainly doesn't help that the Hauler VI is more expensive than four Hauler IIIs.
units.italian: Molti considerano le navi da carico Hauler superate, e non è chiaro se portare lo spazio di carico a sei container basti a rendere popolare questa Hauler. Di certo non aiuta che una Hauler VI costi più di quattro Hauler III.
